classification.reason: The KB explicitly states that two identical charges on the same day is a billing error that must be escalated to a human rather than resolved by the agent.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the trouble. Two charges of the exact same amount on the exact same day is treated as a billing error on our end, not a normal double-charge scenario like a proration — so I've escalated this to our billing team to investigate and correct rather than handling it automatically.

In the meantime, it may help to check Settings > Billing > Invoices to confirm both charges appear there and see if they show as separate line items — but based on what you've described, this looks like the same-day/same-amount case that requires a human to review and resolve. Someone from our team will follow up with you directly on the next steps for correcting the charge.

Thanks for your patience.

verification.notes: Both citations (billing_faq.md:18 on same-day/same-amount charges as escalation-worthy, refund_policy.md:8 on never promising/approving refunds) are accurate and support the claims; the reply only explains policy and escalates without promising a refund amount, and tone is professional, so it passes with the classifier's needs_human_approval=True left unchanged.
